title: Kenyan Coffee Milkshake
community: Urban Kenya — the café afternoon drink
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Coffee Milkshake — rich Kenyan single-origin coffee blended with vanilla ice cream, whole milk, and a drizzle of honey. A celebration of Kenya's world-class coffee in its most indulgent liquid form.
longDesc: A Kenyan coffee milkshake made with Kenya AA or Nyeri single-origin coffee is something extraordinary — the fruit-forward brightness and complex flavour of Kenyan coffee creates a milkshake with more character than any other. Blended with vanilla ice cream and a touch of honey, it is the perfect afternoon treat.
ingredients: 2 shots strong brewed Kenyan coffee — chilled
steps: Brew strong Kenyan coffee and cool completely — or use cold brew.
Combine coffee, ice cream, milk, honey, vanilla, and ice in a blender.
chefTips: Chilled coffee is essential — hot coffee melts the ice cream and ruins the texture.
The coffee flavour should be pronounced — do not dilute with too much milk.
Kenyan single-origin coffee is dramatically better than blended coffee here.
commonMistakes: Warm coffee — melts ice cream too fast.
Too much milk — loses the coffee intensity.
cookingScience: Blending ice cream with cold liquid creates a temporary emulsion of air, fat, and liquid — the air incorporated during blending gives the milkshake its characteristic thick but pourable texture. Over-blending collapses the air bubbles, producing a denser result.
sustainabilityTips: Choose direct-trade Kenyan single-origin coffee to ensure farmers receive fair prices.
healthBenefits: Calcium from milk and ice cream.
culturalNote: A Kenyan coffee milkshake made with Kenya's legendary single-origin beans is a global first-class experience — the fruit-forward brightness of Nyeri AA or Kirinyaga beans transforms a simple milkshake into something genuinely world-class.
